messages:
Alex Chen: hey team — stuck at the airport, delayed flight and my phone's 2FA app died. can't complete VPN login. i'm the primary for tonight's APAC window (00:00-08:00 UTC). incident-bot just paged me for increased latency on embeddings. if someone can shadow or take primary for the next 4–6 hrs pls shout now. sorry for the last-minute ask. :disappointed:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: 1790123456 - High p99 latency on /v1/embeddings (region: eu-west). Pager routed to primary oncall (Alex Chen). Impact: some customers experiencing 2-5s extra latency, retry rates up ~3%. Runbook: /runbooks/embeddings-latency

Maria Gomez: I can take primary for the immediate window, I have VPN access and I'm near a laptop. will take 00:00-04:00 UTC. can someone please hand me the bridge and the pinned runbook steps?

Alex Chen: @Maria thanks so much. i'm transferring context — active customers: two enterprise accounts (acct-omega, acct-nova) seeing elevated latencies on bulk-embed jobs. last successful mitigation was routing to embed-lite-v1 and reducing max_batch. logs showed KV cache thrash on large seqs.

Samir Patel: noted. when you accept, @Maria, quick steps (from runbook):
1) set route fallback to embed-lite-v1 for /v1/embeddings
2) lower max_batch to 8
3) enable prefix KV caching for heavy prefixes

Samir Patel: command snippets from console API:```bash
# temporary route change
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/routes/update -d '{"route":"embeddings","fallback_model":"embed-lite-v1","max_batch":8}'
```
(Also paste the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency)

Leo Wong: i'll stand up the bridge (zoom link) and monitor SLO dashboards. creating bridge now and adding @maria @samir @alex.

oncall-bot: Handoff: primary reassigned from Alex Chen -> Maria Gomez (covering until 1790125056). Secondary remains Samir Patel. Please acknowledge.

Maria Gomez: acknowledged. taking primary. starting with route swap and dropping batch. i'll post results in 5m.

Samir Patel: leaving a note — if routing change doesn't reduce p99 within 3 mins, run the rollback to previous batching and escalate to infra-sre for KV cache investigation.

Maria Gomez: route swap done. metrics: p50 unchanged, p95 down from 1.9s -> 1.2s, p99 down from 3.8s -> 2.1s. retry rate trending down. continuing to monitor.

Alex Chen: thanks @maria and @samir. i'm offline-ish but will be reachable via DM for anything urgent. really appreciate the cover. :pray:

Leo Wong: monitoring on bridge, no customer-facing alerts so far. opening a short post-incident note in #incidents after handoff ends. tagging product for customer outreach if we see continued regressions (cc @product).

Maria Gomez: will keep primary until 04:00 UTC then hand back to Alex if he's back online or to Samir if not. adding a short runbook addendum about 2FA carry (lol).

Alex Chen: i'll follow up with security to get a device bypass for emergencies. again, huge thanks. :thumbsup:
